newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: RAM assigns A1 to Rashid Hussain bonds.
newsitem.headline: RAM assigns A1 to Rashid Hussain bonds.

text.p: Rating Agency Malaysia Bhd (RAM) said on Monday it has assigned a long term rating of A1 to Rashid Hussain Bhd's proposed 800 million ringgit fixed rate bonds.
In a statement, RAM said the bonds were well covered by DCB Holdings Bhd shares.
The rating also took into consideration financial viability of the core subsidiaries of the enlarged DCB Holdings group, which is involved in banking and stockbroking, RAM said.
The agency said it has also reviewed and reaffirmed the P1 rating of Rashid Hussain's 100 million ringgit revolving underwritten facility.
The proposed bonds were part of Rashid Hussain's funding package to refinance its proposed restructuring.
Rashid Hussain has acquired about 75 percent interest in Kwong Yik Bank Bhd and is in the midst of completing a restructuring exercise.
"RAM is of the opinion that RHB (Rashid Hussain), as a well diversified financial services holding grouo, will command a leading position within the industry," the statement said.
